summary.text: David Love is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 13 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning in 2018.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia's campaign contribution history lists general-election wins for David Love in Rockingham 6 in 2018 and 2020, and in Rockingham 13 in 2022 and 2024.

He was assigned to the Fish and Game and Marine Resources Committee for the 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions and to the Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
